prose: A solo developer describes a week of running a small team of agent bots on a Linux server and handing them jobs. He has a support bot that answers customer email through Gmail, an engineer bot that writes code, and a security bot that watches Cloudflare and server logs for anything odd.

What won him over was the bots working with each other: in one case they fixed a customer's bug without him stepping in. He sees this as most useful for a solo founder, where small tasks pile up. It is a personal account of one setup, not an evaluation.
highlights: Solo founder runs support, engineering and security bots on one server.
The bots coordinated to fix a customer bug without him.
